subject: Standby confirmation: Ardent Dynamics Q3 dedicated pool
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Standby confirmation: Ardent Dynamics Q3 dedicated pool

Team —

Ardent Dynamics (Joe Reynolds) is asking for a 90-day soft hold on a dedicated pool for their Q3 POC and a rollout window in mid-August. They want confirmation on the following before we commit a standby:

- Guaranteed floor of 8x A100-equivalent GPUs (can be a mix of vA100/ L40s) for a 4-week contiguous window in Aug (target Aug 10–Sep 7).
- Sustained 1k RPS for embeddings workload during POC (expected avg seq length 512).
- Fallback model options (8-bit quantized variant) in case of capacity pressure.

Can Ops confirm availability and any constraints (region, preemption risk, recommended quantization to reduce footprint)? I attached a current capacity ask template (capacity_matrix_Q3_v2.xlsx) for your inputs.

Joe is sensitive to lead time; he’s asking for a written soft hold (not a contract) and an SLO note that we can share with procurement.

Aisha
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: capacity_matrix_Q3_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet stub: sheet 'asks' with requested GPU windows and models)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Standby confirmation: Ardent Dynamics Q3 dedicated pool

Aisha —

Quick capacity note after an initial scrub of Q3 allocations:

1) Availability:
   - West US cluster (PHX/AK) can support an 8x A100-equivalent contiguous allocation for Aug 10–Sep 7 but with conditions: two of the slots would be on L40s and may require driver/opt tuning for peak latency.
   - We have a maintenance window currently scheduled in AK cluster Aug 15–16; we can negotiate to avoid the specific nodes if we place a soft hold now.

2) Preemption/risk:
   - No preemptible instances for Dedicated (we reserve enterprise-only nodes) but adjacent pool pressure could trigger intra-fleet reshuffles. A soft hold reduces reshuffle risk by earmarking nodes.

3) Performance knobs:
   - Recommend shipping a quantized 8-bit variant for Long-Running inference to reduce footprint by ~38% token cost — we can host both FP16 and 8-bit variants behind the same route and route by policy.

4) Ops ask from Sales to lock in hold:
   - Written confirmation of soft hold window and a one-page SLO summary for procurement.
   - Deal-specific tagging in capacity planner (deal_id AD-2026-Q3-1187).

I populated the capacity_matrix_Q3_v2.xlsx with tentative node IDs and a conservative headroom buffer; see tab 'ops_notes'.

Marcus
Head of Dedicated Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Attachment: capacity_matrix_Q3_v2.xlsx (ops_notes tab updated: node list, maintenance windows)

Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Standby confirmation: Ardent Dynamics Q3 dedicated pool

Hi Aisha —

Thanks for the quick coordination. A few clarifications from procurement:

- The soft hold needs a clear end-date and an explicit condition for release (we typically allow release if a signed contract isn’t in place by T-minus 30 days).
- We need a one-page SLO with latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99) for the FP16 and 8-bit paths and a note on data residency (we prefer West US).
- Are there any cross-region failover obligations? We’ll want to know if Redwood will proactively switch to a secondary region during the Aug maintenance window.

If you can send a draft soft-hold confirmation and the SLO summary this week, procurement will review and revert.

—Joe
VP Product, Ardent Dynamics
joe@ardentdynamics.com

Subject: Confirmation: 90-day soft hold for Ardent Dynamics (AD-2026-Q3-1187)

Joe / Ardent procurement —

Thanks for the questions and patience. Per internal ops and legal alignment, Redwood confirms a 90-day soft hold for Ardent Dynamics with the following terms:

- Soft hold window: Aug 3, 2026 through Oct 1, 2026.
- Release clause: Hold will be released if a signed SOW is not executed by July 4, 2026 (T-minus 30 days).
- Capacity: 8x A100-equivalent GPUs (note: 2 nodes are L40-class; performance tuning is documented in SLO appendix).
- Residency: West US primary. Cross-region failover will be manual and requires pre-approval; Redwood will not automatically fail over during the Aug 15–16 maintenance window but will coordinate a temporary capacity re-route if needed.
- SLO: Attached one-page SLO with p50/p95/p99 for FP16 and 8-bit inference paths.

Attachments: soft_hold_mou.pdf (MOU + SLO one-pager), capacity_matrix_Q3_v2.xlsx (ops node tags).

Next steps:
- Marissa to send the MOU to procurement for countersignature.
- Marcus to tag the nodes and add deal_id AD-2026-Q3-1187 to the planner (Marcus to confirm node tagging by EOD Wed Jun 10).
- Ben to follow up with Joe on the SOW timeline.

Aisha
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
